channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Pakistan’s mediation faces limits as Iran-US tensions deepen
item.description: Tehran and Washington exchange proposals via Pakistan as military escalation increasingly shadows diplomatic efforts.

item.title: Could the Iran war trigger the next debt shock?
item.description: Government bonds are under pressure and households could soon feel the impact.

item.title: Former US negotiator with Iran: Trump falling into Vietnam trap
item.description: Rob Malley argues that current talks have ‘very small chance of success’.

item.title: What is the UAE’s Barakah nuclear plant, nearly hit by a drone?
item.description: The nuclear facility in Abu Dhabi has the capacity to meet one-quarter of the UAE's electricity needs.

item.title: Iran eyes challenging stock market reopening after lengthy war closure
item.description: The capital market is not Iranian economy's main financing engine, but it still matters politically and psychologically.

item.title: The Gulf does not have to choose Iran or Israel
item.description: It has to choose stability or permanent war.

item.title: Iran sends response to US proposal to end war via mediator Pakistan
item.description: Iran demands the release of assets frozen abroad, the lifting of sanctions and control over the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Iran plans to offer insurance for Hormuz transit: Will it work?
item.description: Iran proposes Bitcoin-based ship insurance for the Strait of Hormuz, a move likely to raise global maritime concerns.

item.title: Iran says nuclear enrichment rights cannot be ‘negotiated’
item.description: Iran’s nuclear enrichment is a right that ‘already exists’, foreign ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei said.

item.title: Russian drone hits Chinese ship off Ukraine before Putin meets Xi Jinping
item.description: Ukraine says its territory is attacked overnight with 524 drones and 22 missiles.
